row.notes: (placement, Request *r): r+0x18 = slot (car/grid index <32), r+0x1c = type (5 = copy from another request). Maps slot via +0x988 byte table to a vehicle id, finds the vehicle in [this+0x948]+0x28..+0x30 ([v+0x58]+0xe8 == id) and writes its 4x4 transform to r+0x20..+0x5f; 'VEHICLE_PLACEMENT Invalid slot (%d)'. Callers: cutscene SetGarageLocation/SetGridLocation, PitstopCutScene_Initialise, garage gantry, crew working on car. Addon: grid/garage transforms.
